data.name: Bank Alfalah Limited
data.description: Bank Alfalah Limited is a banking company incorporated in Pakistan on June 21, 1992 as a public limited company. It commenced its banking operations on November 1, 1992. The Bank is engaged in banking services as described in the Banking Companies Ordinance, 1962.
